page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines from top to bottom; an engraved emblem with banner and globe in the middle; handwritten annotations at right (not transcribed); no margins with text.

main_text.l: Simplices & nativas rerum nomenclationes, è Ianua linguæ Latinæ jam notas, in elegantes varie commutare docens.

page.notes: Engraving: an eagle with spread wings holding a banner inscribed "VINTVS" and "INGENIO", perched above a globe, flanked by two figures (a boy with a book/compass and a man with a staff). Handwritten ink annotations at right, partly cut off ("Juze me emp... possidet Da... ...nay ... 1669 ... Const: i ...") were not transcribed as printed text. Faint show-through from the reverse page throughout. Title line "LEXICON" and "Latino - Latinum" are in red; "JOANNEM JANSSONIUM" in red. The date is printed as clɔ Iɔ c LVII, i.e. MDCLVII (1657).
